load_assemble_list.label: Load assemble list
load_assemble_list.tooltip: Load assemble object list from config file.

datadir.label: Data directory
datadir.tooltip: Load and store settings at the given directory. This is useful for maintaining different profiles or including configurations from a network storage.

outputdir.label: Output directory
outputdir.tooltip: This is the output directory for exported files.

enable_timelapse.label: Enable timelapse for print
enable_timelapse.tooltip: If enabled, this slicing will be considered using timelapse.

load_filament_ids.label: Load filament IDs
load_filament_ids.tooltip: Load filament IDs for each object.

allow_multicolor_oneplate.label: Allow multiple colors on one plate
allow_multicolor_oneplate.tooltip: If enabled, Arrange will allow multiple colors on one plate.

allow_rotations.label: Allow rotation when arranging
allow_rotations.tooltip: If enabled, Arrange will allow rotation when placing objects.

avoid_extrusion_cali_region.label: Avoid extrusion calibrate region when arranging
avoid_extrusion_cali_region.tooltip: If enabled, Arrange will avoid extrusion calibrate region when placing objects.

skip_modified_gcodes.label: Skip modified G-code in 3MF
skip_modified_gcodes.tooltip: Skip the modified G-code in 3MF from printer or filament presets.

allow_newer_file.label: Allow 3MF with newer version to be sliced
allow_newer_file.tooltip: Allow 3MF with newer version to be sliced.

allow_mix_temp.label: Allow filaments with high/low temperature to be printed together
allow_mix_temp.tooltip: Allow filaments with high/low temperature to be printed together.

zhop.label: Current Z-hop
zhop.tooltip: Contains Z-hop present at the beginning of the custom G-code block.

position.label: Position
position.tooltip: Position of the extruder at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code travels somewhere else, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer knows where it travels from when it gets control back.

e_retracted.label: Retraction
e_retracted.tooltip: Retraction state at the beginning of the custom G-code block. If the custom G-code moves the extruder axis, it should write to this variable so OrcaSlicer de-retracts correctly when it gets control back.

e_restart_extra.label: Extra de-retraction
e_restart_extra.tooltip: Currently planned extra extruder priming after de-retraction.

e_position.label: Absolute E position
e_position.tooltip: Current position of the extruder axis. Only used with absolute extruder addressing.

current_extruder.label: Current extruder
current_extruder.tooltip: Zero-based index of currently used extruder.

current_object_idx.label: Current object index
current_object_idx.tooltip: Specific for sequential printing. Zero-based index of currently printed object.

has_wipe_tower.label: Has wipe tower
has_wipe_tower.tooltip: Whether or not wipe tower is being generated in the print.

initial_extruder.label: Initial extruder
initial_extruder.tooltip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_tool.

initial_tool.label: Initial tool
initial_tool.tooltip: Zero-based index of the first extruder used in the print. Same as initial_extruder.

is_extruder_used.label: Is extruder used?
is_extruder_used.tooltip: Vector of booleans stating whether a given extruder is used in the print.

num_extruders.label: Number of extruders
num_extruders.tooltip: Total number of extruders, regardless of whether they are used in the current print.

has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.label: Has single extruder MM priming
has_single_extruder_multi_material_primi.tooltip: Are the extra multi-material priming regions used in this print?

extruded_volume.label: Volume per extruder
extruded_volume.tooltip: Total filament volume extruded per extruder during the entire print.

total_toolchanges.label: Total tool changes
total_toolchanges.tooltip: Number of tool changes during the print.

extruded_volume_total.label: Total volume
extruded_volume_total.tooltip: Total volume of filament used during the entire print.

extruded_weight.label: Weight per extruder
extruded_weight.tooltip: Weight per extruder extruded during the entire print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

extruded_weight_total.label: Total weight
extruded_weight_total.tooltip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

total_layer_count.label: Total layer count
total_layer_count.tooltip: Number of layers in the entire print.

normal_print_time.label: Print time (normal mode)
normal_print_time.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as print_time.

print_time.label: Print time (normal mode)
print_time.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in normal mode (i.e. not in silent mode). Same as normal_print_time.

silent_print_time.label: Print time (silent mode)
silent_print_time.tooltip: Estimated print time when printed in silent mode.

total_cost.label: Total cost
total_cost.tooltip: Total cost of all material used in the print. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.

total_weight.label: Total weight
total_weight.tooltip: Total weight of the print. Calculated from filament_density value in Filament Settings.

total_wipe_tower_cost.label: Total wipe tower cost
total_wipe_tower_cost.tooltip: Total cost of the material wasted on the wipe tower. Calculated from filament_cost value in Filament Settings.

total_wipe_tower_filament.label: Wipe tower volume
total_wipe_tower_filament.tooltip: Total filament volume extruded on the wipe tower.

used_filament.label: Used filament
used_filament.tooltip: Total length of filament used in the print.

print_time_sec.label: Print time (seconds)
print_time_sec.tooltip: Total estimated print time in seconds. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

used_filament_length.label: Filament length (meters)
used_filament_length.tooltip: Total filament length used in meters. Replaced with actual value during post-processing.

num_objects.label: Number of objects
num_objects.tooltip: Total number of objects in the print.

num_instances.label: Number of instances
num_instances.tooltip: Total number of object instances in the print, summed over all objects.

input_filename_base.label: Input filename without extension
input_filename_base.tooltip: Source filename of the first object, without extension.

first_layer_print_convex_hull.label: First layer convex hull
first_layer_print_convex_hull.tooltip: Vector of points of the first layer convex hull. Each element has the following format:'[x, y]' (x and y are floating-point numbers in mm).

first_layer_print_min.label: Bottom-left corner of the first layer bounding box

first_layer_print_max.label: Top-right corner of the first layer bounding box

first_layer_print_size.label: Size of the first layer bounding box

print_bed_min.label: Bottom-left corner of print bed bounding box

print_bed_max.label: Top-right corner of print bed bounding box

print_bed_size.label: Size of the print bed bounding box

timestamp.label: Timestamp
timestamp.tooltip: String containing current time in yyyyMMdd-hhmmss format.

print_preset.label: Print preset name
print_preset.tooltip: Name of the print preset used for slicing.

filament_preset.label: Filament preset name
filament_preset.tooltip: Names of the filament presets used for slicing. The variable is a vector containing one name for each extruder.

printer_preset.label: Printer preset name
printer_preset.tooltip: Name of the printer preset used for slicing.

physical_printer_preset.label: Physical printer name
physical_printer_preset.tooltip: Name of the physical printer used for slicing.

layer_num.label: Layer number
layer_num.tooltip: Index of the current layer. One-based (i.e. first layer is number 1).

layer_z.label: Layer Z
layer_z.tooltip: Height of the current layer above the print bed, measured to the top of the layer.

max_layer_z.label: Maximal layer Z
max_layer_z.tooltip: Height of the last layer above the print bed.

filament_extruder_id.label: Filament extruder ID
filament_extruder_id.tooltip: The current extruder ID. The same as current_extruder.

machine_max_acceleration_x.tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the X axis

machine_max_acceleration_y.tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the Y axis

machine_max_acceleration_z.tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the Z axis

machine_max_acceleration_e.tooltip: Maximum acceleration of the E axis

machine_max_jerk_x.tooltip: Maximum jerk of the X axis

machine_max_jerk_y.tooltip: Maximum jerk of the Y axis

machine_max_jerk_z.tooltip: Maximum jerk of the Z axis

machine_max_jerk_e.tooltip: Maximum jerk of the E axis

filament_retraction_length.label: Length
filament_retraction_length.tooltip: Some amount of material in extruder is pulled back to avoid ooze during long travel. Set zero to disable retraction.

filament_z_hop.label: Z-hop height
filament_z_hop.tooltip: Whenever there is a retraction, the nozzle is lifted a little to create clearance between the nozzle and the print. This prevents the nozzle from hitting the print when traveling more. Using spiral lines to lift z can prevent stringing.

filament_retract_lift_above.label: Only lift Z above
filament_retract_lift_above.tooltip: If you set this to a positive value, Z lift will only take place above the specified absolute Z.

filament_retract_lift_below.label: Only lift Z below
filament_retract_lift_below.tooltip: If you set this to a positive value, Z lift will only take place below the specified absolute Z.

filament_retract_lift_enforce.label: On surfaces
filament_retract_lift_enforce.tooltip: Enforce Z-Hop behavior. This setting is impacted by the above settings (Only lift Z above/below).

filament_retraction_speed.label: Retraction speed
filament_retraction_speed.tooltip: Speed for retracting filament from the nozzle.

filament_deretraction_speed.label: Deretraction speed
filament_deretraction_speed.tooltip: Speed for reloading filament into the nozzle. Zero means same speed of retraction.

filament_retract_restart_extra.label: Extra length on restart
filament_retract_restart_extra.tooltip: When the retraction is compensated after the travel move, the extruder will push this additional amount of filament. This setting is rarely needed.

filament_retraction_minimum_travel.label: Travel distance threshold
filament_retraction_minimum_travel.tooltip: Only trigger retraction when the travel distance is longer than this threshold.

filament_wipe_distance.label: Wipe distance
filament_wipe_distance.tooltip:
Describe how long the nozzle will move along the last path when retracting.

Depending on how long the wipe operation lasts, how fast and long the extruder/filament retraction settings are, a retraction move may be needed to retract the remaining filament.

Setting a value in the retract amount before wipe setting below will perform any excess retraction before the wipe, else it will be performed after.

filament_retract_when_changing_layer.label: Retract on layer change
filament_retract_when_changing_layer.tooltip: This forces a retraction on layer changes.

filament_wipe.label: Wipe while retracting
filament_wipe.tooltip: This moves the nozzle along the last extrusion path when retracting to clean any leaked material on the nozzle. This can minimize blobs when printing a new part after traveling.

filament_retract_before_wipe.label: Retract amount before wipe
filament_retract_before_wipe.tooltip: This is the length of fast retraction before a wipe, relative to retraction length.

filament_retract_after_wipe.label: Retract amount after wipe
filament_retract_after_wipe.tooltip:
The length of fast retraction after wipe, relative to retraction length.
The value will be clamped by 100% minus the retract amount before the wipe value.

filament_long_retractions_when_cut.label: Long retraction when cut (beta)
filament_long_retractions_when_cut.tooltip: Experimental feature: Retracting and cutting off the filament at a longer distance during changes to minimize purge. While this reduces flush significantly, it may also raise the risk of nozzle clogs or other printing problems.

filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.label: Retraction distance when cut
filament_retraction_distances_when_cut.tooltip: Experimental feature: Retraction length before cutting off during filament change.

branchingsupport_head_front_diameter.label: Pinhead front diameter
branchingsupport_head_front_diameter.tooltip: Diameter of the pointing side of the head

branchingsupport_head_penetration.label: Head penetration
branchingsupport_head_penetration.tooltip: How much the pinhead has to penetrate the model surface

branchingsupport_head_width.label: Pinhead width
branchingsupport_head_width.tooltip: Width from the back sphere center to the front sphere center

branchingsupport_pillar_diameter.label: Pillar diameter
branchingsupport_pillar_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the support pillars

branchingsupport_small_pillar_diameter_p.label: Small pillar diameter percent
branchingsupport_small_pillar_diameter_p.tooltip: The percentage of smaller pillars compared to the normal pillar diameter which are used in problematic areas where a normal pilla cannot fit.

branchingsupport_max_bridges_on_pillar.label: Max bridges on a pillar
branchingsupport_max_bridges_on_pillar.tooltip: Maximum number of bridges that can be placed on a pillar. Bridges hold support point pinheads and connect to pillars as small branches.

support_max_weight_on_model.label: Max weight on model
support_max_weight_on_model.tooltip: Maximum weight of sub-trees that terminate on the model instead of the print bed. The weight is the sum of the lenghts of all branches emanating from the endpoint.

branchingsupport_max_weight_on_model.label: Max weight on model
branchingsupport_max_weight_on_model.tooltip: Maximum weight of sub-trees that terminate on the model instead of the print bed. The weight is the sum of the lenghts of all branches emanating from the endpoint.

branchingsupport_pillar_connection_mode.label: Pillar connection mode
branchingsupport_pillar_connection_mode.tooltip: Controls the bridge type between two neighboring pillars. Can be zig-zag, cross (double zig-zag) or dynamic which will automatically switch between the first two depending on the distance of the two pillars.

branchingsupport_buildplate_only.label: Support on build plate only
branchingsupport_buildplate_only.tooltip: Only create support if it lies on a build plate. Don't create support on a print.

branchingsupport_pillar_widening_factor.label: Pillar widening factor
branchingsupport_pillar_widening_factor.tooltip: Merging bridges or pillars into another pillars can increase the radius. Zero means no increase, one means full increase. The exact amount of increase is unspecified and can change in the future.

branchingsupport_base_diameter.label: Support base diameter
branchingsupport_base_diameter.tooltip: Diameter in mm of the pillar base

branchingsupport_base_height.label: Support base height
branchingsupport_base_height.tooltip: The height of the pillar base cone

branchingsupport_base_safety_distance.label: Support base safety distance
branchingsupport_base_safety_distance.tooltip: The minimum distance of the pillar base from the model in mm. Makes sense in zero elevation mode where a gap according to this parameter is inserted between the model and the pad.

branchingsupport_critical_angle.label: Critical angle
branchingsupport_critical_angle.tooltip: The default angle for connecting support sticks and junctions.

branchingsupport_max_bridge_length.label: Max bridge length
branchingsupport_max_bridge_length.tooltip: The max length of a bridge

branchingsupport_max_pillar_link_distanc.label: Max pillar linking distance
branchingsupport_max_pillar_link_distanc.tooltip: The max distance of two pillars to get linked with each other. A zero value will prohibit pillar cascading.

branchingsupport_object_elevation.label: Object elevation
branchingsupport_object_elevation.tooltip: How much the supports should lift up the supported object. If "Pad around object" is enabled, this value is ignored.

high_viscosity_tilt_time.label: High viscosity
high_viscosity_tilt_time.tooltip: Time of the super slow tilt

printing_temperature.label: Printing temperature
printing_temperature.tooltip: This value sets the target printing temperature. The printer will wait for the resin to reach this stable temperature before starting and will maintain it throughout the print. When disabled, the printer ignores the resin's current temperature and begins printing immediately.

zcorrection_layers.label: Z compensation
zcorrection_layers.tooltip: Number of layers to Z correct to avoid cross layer bleed

material_notes.label: SLA print material notes
material_notes.tooltip: You can put your notes regarding the SLA print material here.

support_enforcers_only.label: Support only in enforced regions
support_enforcers_only.tooltip: Only create support if it lies in a support enforcer.

sla_archive_format.label: Format of the output SLA archive

delay_before_exposure.tooltip: Sets a fixed pause before an exposure of the new layer starts. This setting is ignored if 'Dynamic delay before exposure' is enabled.

delay_after_exposure.tooltip: Delay after exposure before layer separation.

delay_to_reflood.tooltip: Defines the pause between the separation movement (tilt down, Z-hop) and the return movement (tilt up). Increasing this time allows the resin more time to fully reflood the peeled-off layer.

tower_hop_height.tooltip: An alternative separation move to tilting. After layer exposure, the platform lifts by this distance. A minimum of 5mm is recommended if tilting is disabled. If you use tilting, we suggest 0mm, although a combination of both is possible.

tower_speed.tooltip: Tower speed used for tower raise.

tilt_down_initial_speed.tooltip: Sets the initial speed for the tilt-down separation move. A high speed may negatively affect print quality or success, especially with certain resins or delicate geometries, but it speeds up the overall print time.

tilt_down_finish_speed.tooltip: Sets the final speed for the tilt-down separation move. Too high a speed, especially with less viscous resins, can cause resin to splash out of the tank.

tilt_up_initial_speed.tooltip: Sets the initial speed for the tilt-up return movement.

tilt_up_finish_speed.tooltip: Sets the final speed for the tilt-up return movement. Excessive speed, especially with highly viscous resins, can lead to a loss of print quality, or in extreme cases, tilt motor skipping or damage to the print display.

tilt_down_initial_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for an initial portion of tilt down move.

tilt_down_finish_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for the rest of the tilt down move.

tilt_up_initial_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for an initial portion of tilt up move.

tilt_up_finish_speed_slx.tooltip: Tilt speed used for the rest of the tilt-up.

dynamic_delay_before_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic delay before exposure function behaves.

dynamic_delay_before_timeout.tooltip: Sets the maximum allowed time for waiting for the pressure sensors to stabilize during dynamic delay before exposure. Once this timeout expires, the printer starts exposing the next layer regardless of resin pressure stabilization.

dynamic_tilt_up_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic tilt up function behaves.

dynamic_tilt_down_profile.tooltip: Switches between predefined algorithms that influence how the dynamic tilt down function behaves.

use_tilt.tooltip: Enables or disables the tilting function. If disabled, the layer separation is performed using the 'Tower hop height' parameter.

tilt_down_offset_steps.tooltip: Defines the distance (steps) over which the 'Tilt down initial speed' is applied. Once this distance is covered, the tilt moves at the 'Tilt down finish speed'. Setting to 0 immediately applies the finish speed. Maximum distance varies by printer, typically around 12,000 steps.

tilt_down_offset_delay.tooltip: Delay after the tilt reaches 'tilt_down_offset_steps' position.

tilt_down_cycles.tooltip: Number of cycles to split the rest of the tilt down move.

tilt_up_offset_steps.tooltip: Defines the distance over which the 'Tilt up initial speed' is applied. After this distance, the tilt moves at the 'Tilt up finish speed'. Setting to 0 immediately applies the finish speed.

tilt_up_offset_delay.tooltip: Delay after the tilt reaches 'tilt_up_offset_steps' position.

tilt_up_cycles.tooltip: Number of cycles to split the rest of the tilt-up.
